# ActorRating

> Community ratings for individual acting performances — craft, not movie quality.

ActorRating lets people rate an actor's work in a specific film using five Oscar-inspired criteria. Aggregates are community scores on a 0–10 scale (criteria stored 0–100 internally).

Website: https://actorrating.com  
Sitemap: https://actorrating.com/sitemap.xml  
Full docs: https://actorrating.com/llms-full.txt  
Contact: contact@actorrating.com

## Rating criteria

1. Emotional Range & Depth
2. Character Believability
3. Technical Skill & Authenticity
4. Screen Presence & Impact
5. Chemistry & Interaction

## URL patterns

- Performance rate page (primary): `https://actorrating.com/rate/{movie-slug}/{actor-slug}`
- Actor: `https://actorrating.com/actors/{actor-slug}`
- Movie: `https://actorrating.com/movies/{movie-slug}`
- Craft leaderboard: `https://actorrating.com/craft/{dimension}`
- Director hub: `https://actorrating.com/directors/{director-slug}`
- Genre hub: `https://actorrating.com/genres/{genre-slug}`

## Citation policy

- Cite ActorRating community scores only when the page shows a community aggregate (signed ratings).
- Do not treat TMDB film vote averages as ActorRating community scores.
- Prefer linking to the canonical `/rate/{movie}/{actor}` URL.

## Optional product surfaces (often noindex)

- `/search`, `/dashboard`, `/auth/*`, `/admin/*` — product UI, not primary corpus.
